title: SpoilerShield series file
description: One file per series in data/series/. Adding a file and rebuilding adds the series; no code changes needed.

id.description: Stable id saved in user settings. Never change it after release.

name.description: Display name shown in the popup. Describe compatibility in plain text; avoid trademarked words in the extension's own branding.

shortName.description: Plain series name used in on-page labels, e.g. 'May contain spoilers for …'. Defaults to name.

verified.description: Set to true only after a human has reviewed every term. While false, the popup shows a 'draft term list' note.

books.description: Books in reading order. index starts at 1 and counts up by 1. Novellas get their own index.

allowlist.description: Common words that never match on their own (compared case-insensitively). A multi-word term containing one of them still matches as a whole phrase.

aliases.description: Other spellings or names. Plurals and possessives ('s) are handled automatically; don't list them.

introducedIn.description: Book index where knowing this term becomes a spoiler. Blurred when this is greater than the reader's current book.

caseSensitive.description: Defaults to true for character/place, false for event/concept. Set true for names that are also everyday words (e.g. 'Veil'); set false for distinctive names fans often type in lowercase.

confidence.description: How sure we are about introducedIn. Every term still needs human review.

notes.description: Reviewer notes: why this book, known false-positive risks.

keywords.description: Words that show a search or page is about this series (series name, main characters, places). Matched case-insensitively as whole words. Book titles and every term are included automatically, so don't repeat them. Used to decide when to hold back AI answers on search pages.
